title: 3 PIECES OF CANADIAN BLUE MOUN...
reason: Three Blue Mountain Pottery style drip-glaze pieces (tall swan, dolphin, large vase), a known collectable maker; no marks visible and the dolphin is damaged per the title.
findings: Three pieces of green, turquoise and black drip-glazed pottery: a tall long-necked swan or goose figure, a diving dolphin figure on a wave base, and a large shouldered vase with a flared mouth. Glaze colour and forms are typical of Blue Mountain Pottery (Collingwood, Ontario, Canada), consistent with the title. No BMP stamp, incised mark or paper label can be read because no bases are photographed; the tag on the swan's neck is illegible. The dolphin's tail looks intact in the photo despite the title mentioning tail damage (a small chip or repair could be hidden at this resolution). The title's 'H-144 CM' cannot be right for any piece shown (probably a typo).
condition: Per the title, damage to the dolphin tail; in the photo the tail tips look intact, so any chip or repair is small. Glaze glossy with no obvious chips or cracks on the swan or vase from the angle shown; bases and undersides not shown.
rescore_note: Turquoise-green drip glaze and forms fit Blue Mountain Pottery, a common maker with modest prices; the tall swan and large vase carry the lot but the dolphin is reported damaged and no base marks are visible; sits on the line between the $30-80 and $80-200 bands (judgement, no live comps this run).
